nodes.label: Neutron Eta-prime Feasibility
nodes.rationale: The channel is scientifically novel but conditional on at least about 1000 clean archived D2 events because Fermi motion, low neutron efficiency, absent neutron momentum, and threshold-limited statistics compound.

nodes.label: Polarization Data Format Blocker
nodes.rationale: The perpendicular/parallel encoding in real events is not recoverable from the repository and requires human input before Sigma extraction can be implemented.

nodes.label: High-energy Polarization Rise
nodes.rationale: Both curves rise with backscattered photon energy and approach about 0.95 near their Compton endpoints; the 351 nm curve reaches the higher photon-energy range.

nodes.label: Dominant Stage-1 Feature
nodes.rationale: best_chi2_eta_pi0 contributes roughly 0.87 of gain and overwhelmingly dominates all other displayed features.

nodes.label: Near-Perfect Stage-1 Discrimination
nodes.rationale: The ROC curve rises to near-unit TPR at very low FPR, and the reported AUC is 0.999.

nodes.label: Strong Signal-Background Score Separation
nodes.rationale: Background density is concentrated near score 0, signal density near score 1, and the 0.28 threshold lies between the two modes.

nodes.label: Slot 0 Prediction Dominance
nodes.rationale: The matrix shows 194472 correct slot-0 predictions, while many true slot-1 and slot-2 cases are predicted as slot 0 (2711 and 53 respectively).

nodes.label: Block-1 Feature Dominance
nodes.rationale: m_high_block1 and chi2_block1 have the two largest gains, about 0.23 and 0.20, followed by dm_eta_block1 near 0.06.

nodes.label: Eta Reconstruction Agreement
nodes.rationale: The chi2, BDT, and truth histograms nearly coincide across the eta-mass distribution.

nodes.label: Pi0 Reconstruction Agreement
nodes.rationale: The chi2, BDT, and truth histograms nearly coincide around the narrow pi0 peak and throughout the tails.

nodes.label: Convergent BDT Learning
nodes.rationale: Training and validation logloss fall rapidly from about 0.103 and then improve more gradually through 400 boosting rounds.

nodes.label: Small Generalization Gap
nodes.rationale: Validation loss remains slightly above training loss and ends near 0.038 versus approximately 0.032 for training.
